items.title: 2.10 Electronic configuration aur semiconductors ka banna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.10, printed pages 41-42.

blocks.text: Semiconductors woh materials hain jo kuch khaas halaat mein bijli guzaarte (conduct karte) hain. Yeh bohat se electronic aalaat mein lagte hain, jaise smartphones, laptops aur gaariyan.

Silicon, germanium aur arsenic waghaira semiconductor ka kaam kar sakte hain. Yeh in elements ki khaas electronic configuration ki wajah se mumkin hai. Aaiye Si ki misal se dekhein ke isay p-type aur n-type semiconductor kaise banaya jata hai.

₁₄Si ki configuration 2, 8, 4 hai, yani us ke valence shell mein 4 electrons hain. Khalis (pure) crystal mein har Si atom chaar doosre Si atoms se bonds bana leta hai. Is halat mein crystal mein se electrons ke behne (electronic conduction) ka koi imkaan nahi.

blocks.alt: Khalis silicon ka crystal: nau Si atoms chakor tarteeb mein, har ek apne chaar parosiyon se covalent bonds se jura hai; har bond ek lens ki shakal hai jis mein do electrons hain, har atom se ek; kinaron se bhi bonds bahar ja rahe hain. Labels: Covalent bond, Silicon valence electrons, Silicon atoms.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.17: Khalis silicon ka crystal (kitab ki Figure 2.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har Si atom ke chaar valence electrons chaar parosi atoms ke saath covalent bonds mein lage hain (har bond mein do electrons). Koi electron azad nahi, is liye pure silicon bijli nahi guzaarta.

P-type aur N-type semiconductors pure semiconductor mein thore se doosre (impurity) atoms milane se bante hain; isay “doping” kehte hain. Trivalent (3 valence electrons wali) impurity, jaise boron ya aluminium, dalein to P-type banta hai. Pentavalent (5 valence electrons wali) impurity, jaise phosphorus ya arsenic, dalein to N-type banta hai. Farq yeh hai ke impurity lattice mein “holes” (positive charge carriers) banati hai to P-type, aur faltu electrons (negative charge carriers) deti hai to N-type.

blocks.prompt: Pure silicon ke paas chaar valence electrons hain, phir bhi woh bijli kyun nahi guzaarta?
blocks.explanation: Chaaron valence electrons parosi Si atoms ke saath bonds mein band hain, is liye charge le jaane ke liye koi azad electron ya hole nahi. Doping holes ya faltu electrons daal kar current chalne deti hai.

items: Semiconductors (Si, Ge) kuch halaat mein conduct karte hain; pure Si (2, 8, 4) ke sab electrons bonds mein hain, is liye conduct nahi karta.
Doping: trivalent (B, Al) se P-type (holes); pentavalent (P, As) se N-type (faltu electrons).
